title: Clark Phil-Kor Half Marathon 2026 Review: A Korea-Philippines Friendship Run
seo_title: Clark Phil-Kor Half Marathon 2026 Review | Clark Pampanga Race
meta_description: The Clark Phil-Kor Half Marathon 2026: November 22 at Clark Parade Grounds, Pampanga. 21K, 10K, 5K, and 3K with registration open — a Korea-Philippines friendship run reviewed.
dek: Set for 22 November 2026 at the Clark Parade Grounds in Pampanga, this SMOKE10 Events-organised half marathon offers four distances with registration open. A Korea-Philippines cultural run in one of the country's best running venues.
verdict: The Clark Phil-Kor Half Marathon combines SMOKE10 Events' race production with the Clark Freeport's wide, well-maintained roads — one of the Philippines' best running environments. Four distances (21K, 10K, 5K, 3K) and open registration make it accessible and bookable now. The Korea-Philippines theme adds a cultural dimension that distinguishes it from generic city races. A solid pick for Clark/Pampanga-based runners and Manila runners looking for a close-to-home race outside the capital.

sections.heading: Clark: Wide Roads, Zero Traffic
paragraphs: Clark Freeport's wide boulevards and minimal traffic — a legacy of the former US airbase — provide one of the Philippines' flattest, fastest road-running environments. [1] The Clark Parade Grounds is a central, open venue with space for a full race village. November in Pampanga is dry-season, with comfortable morning temperatures.

sections.heading: Should You Run It?
paragraphs: If you want an accessible, well-venued half marathon in Clark with open registration, the Phil-Kor Half Marathon delivers. The 2026 edition is set for 22 November at Clark Parade Grounds. [1]
